editorial:
Imagine getting back together with your old school buddies only to find out you are accidentally in the middle of a global conspiracy. That is exactly what happens here. You get a great mix of nostalgic friendship and high-stakes chaos that feels like a giant party on screen. The vibe is light and breezy, making you feel like you are part of the group as they go from laughing about old times to running for their lives. It is the kind of movie that does not take itself too seriously, which makes the wild plot twists much easier to swallow.

Everything moves fast, and the action scenes are top-notch because Sam Hargrave knows how to film a fight. The chemistry between the leads is the best part, though some of the plot holes might bug you if you think too hard about them. If you want a fun night in, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the explosions clearly. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for the bonus features. It is a perfect pick for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes down to a massive showdown at a hidden base. You find out the main villain was actually the group's old teacher who wanted to rewrite history. The friends use their old childhood games to trick the guards and shut down the machine. In the end, they save the world and decide to stay in touch for real this time. They end the movie by opening a travel agency together to keep the adventure going.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies with a lot of heart and humor.
